_note: 083-group-delimiter-resolution T063/T066 SEED baseline — linux-clang-RELEASE (2026-08-01). FR-022 path 1 (inbound validate). These are NEW rows, so there is no prior baseline to compare against; instead the SAME bench file was built and run against the PRE-083 library (a detached worktree at merge-base 0539b56d) so the Article VIII §2 +/-5% budget is measured, not asserted. Medians over 9 --benchmark_repetitions at --benchmark_min_time=0.5s, same host, runs sequential (not concurrent). VERDICT: path 1 is WITHIN budget on every comparable row. BM_ValidateGroup_DivergentContext has NO pre-083 counterpart — the pre-083 library REJECTED that frame during warm-up ('IncrementalX fixture is not conformant'), which is the defect this feature fixes; it is recorded as a new row, never as a regression.

benchmarks.name: BM_ValidateGroup_NoGroup
benchmarks.fixture: Heartbeat(35=0) — no group; every entry short-circuits on the group_bits_ pre-filter
benchmarks.verdict: WITHIN — the common path did not acquire a string hash, which was the main regression risk

benchmarks.name: BM_ValidateGroup_FirstSeenContext
benchmarks.fixture: 35=W MarketDataSnapshotFullRefresh — NoMDEntries(268) in MDFullGrp, first-seen context (pre- and post-083 resolve the SAME delimiter 269), so this row isolates lookup COST from behaviour change
benchmarks.verdict: WITHIN — the context probe (string_view + path span hash) costs ~20 ns per group-bearing message vs the old uint16 hash

benchmarks.name: BM_ValidateGroup_DivergentContext
benchmarks.fixture: 35=X MarketDataIncrementalRefresh — the SAME NoMDEntries(268) in MDIncGrp, delimiter MDUpdateAction(279)
benchmarks.pre083_status: REJECTED — validate() refused this conforming frame on the pre-083 library (the L-063-3 residual-(b) false-reject)
benchmarks.verdict: NEW CAPABILITY — no pre-083 counterpart exists, so no delta is claimed
